list.name: Carol B.
list.text: Mike fixed a door that's been sticking for two years, patched three drywall holes, and installed a new ceiling fan — all in one visit. Charged exactly what he quoted. I already have his number saved for next time.

list.name: Tom & Linda R.
list.text: We had a list of about ten small things that had been piling up. Mike knocked them all out in a day and a half. Fair hourly rate, no surprise charges, and he cleaned up after himself. This is exactly what you want in a handyman.

list.name: Diane M.
list.text: As a single homeowner I'm always nervous about hiring someone I don't know. Mike came recommended by my neighbor and he did not disappoint. Replaced two exterior door locks and fixed a leaky bathroom faucet. Professional and respectful of my home.

list.name: Greg S.
list.text: Called on a Tuesday, he was here Thursday. Fixed a rotted section of deck board and replaced two fence pickets. Price was fair, the work looks great, and he was done by noon. Exactly what I needed.
